00073 void DelayNUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00074 {
00075     double sampleRate = UGen::getSampleRate();
00076     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00077     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00078     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00079     float* delayTimeSamples = inputs[DelayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00080     LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, bufferSamples);
00081     LOCAL_DECLARE(const double, delayBufferSize);
00082     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, bufferWritePos);
00083     
00084     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00085     {
00086         int bufferSamplesRemaining = delayBufferSize - bufferWritePos;
00087         
00088         int numFramesThisTime = ugen::min(bufferSamplesRemaining, numSamplesToProcess);
00089         numSamplesToProcess -= numFramesThisTime;
00090         
00091         while(numFramesThisTime--)
00092         {
00093             bufferSamples[bufferWritePos] = *inputSamples++;
00094             
00095             int bufferReadPos = bufferWritePos - (int)(*delayTimeSamples++ * sampleRate);
00096             if(bufferReadPos < 0)
00097                 bufferReadPos += (int)delayBufferSize;
00098             
00099             *outputSamples++ = bufferSamples[bufferReadPos];
00100             
00101             bufferWritePos++;
00102         }
00103         
00104         if(bufferWritePos >= delayBufferSize)
00105             bufferWritePos = 0;
00106     }   
00107     
00108     LOCAL_COPY(bufferWritePos);
00109 }

00380     {

00397             if(bufferReadPos < 0)
00398                 bufferReadPos += (int)delayBufferSize;
00399             
00400             float value = bufferSamples[bufferReadPos];
00401             
00402             bufferSamples[bufferWritePos] = value * feedback + *inputSamples++;
00403             
00404             *outputSamples++ = value;
00405             
00406             bufferWritePos++;
00407         }
00408         
00409         if(bufferWritePos >= delayBufferSize)
00410             bufferWritePos = 0;

00413     LOCAL_COPY(bufferWritePos);

00503 void AllpassNUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00504 {
00505     double sampleRate = UGen::getSampleRate();
00506     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00507     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00508     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00509     float* delayTimeSamples = inputs[DelayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00510     float* decayTimeSamples = inputs[DecayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00511     bool doesNotNeedToCalculate = true;
00512     LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, bufferSamples);
00513     LOCAL_DECLARE(const double, delayBufferSize);
00514     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, bufferWritePos);
00515     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, currentDelay);
00516     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, currentDecay);
00517     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, feedback);
00518     
00519     ugen_assert(*delayTimeSamples >= 0.f); // not foolproof but better than checking every sample
00520     ugen_assert(*decayTimeSamples >= 0.f); // not foolproof but better than checking every sample
00521     
00522     if(*decayTimeSamples != currentDecay)   
00523     {
00524         currentDecay = *decayTimeSamples;
00525         doesNotNeedToCalculate = false;
00526         LOCAL_COPY(currentDecay);
00527     }
00528     
00529     float nextDelay = (float)(*delayTimeSamples * sampleRate);
00530     
00531     if(nextDelay != currentDelay)   
00532     {
00533         currentDelay = nextDelay;
00534         doesNotNeedToCalculate = false;
00535         LOCAL_COPY(currentDelay);
00536     }
00538     
00539     if(doesNotNeedToCalculate == false)
00540     {
00541         feedback = calcFeedback(*delayTimeSamples, currentDecay);
00542         LOCAL_COPY(feedback);
00543     }
00544     
00545     float currentDelayMax1 = std::max(1.f, currentDelay);
00546     
00547     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00548     {
00549         int bufferSamplesRemaining = delayBufferSize - bufferWritePos;
00550         
00551         int numFramesThisTime = ugen::min(bufferSamplesRemaining, numSamplesToProcess);
00552         numSamplesToProcess -= numFramesThisTime;
00553 
00554         while(numFramesThisTime--)
00555         {
00556             int bufferReadPos = bufferWritePos - (int)(currentDelayMax1);
00557             if(bufferReadPos < 0)
00558                 bufferReadPos += (int)delayBufferSize;
00559             
00560             float inValue = bufferSamples[bufferReadPos];
00561             float outValue = inValue * feedback + *inputSamples++;
00562             
00563             bufferSamples[bufferWritePos] = outValue;
00564             
00565             *outputSamples++ = inValue - feedback * outValue;
00566             
00567             bufferWritePos++;
00568         }
00569         
00570         if(bufferWritePos >= delayBufferSize)
00571             bufferWritePos = 0;
00572     }   
00573     
00574     LOCAL_COPY(bufferWritePos);
00575 }

00617     }
00618     
00619     float nextDelay = (float)(*delayTimeSamples * sampleRate);
00620     
00621     if(nextDelay != currentDelay)   
00622     {
00623         currentDelay = nextDelay;
00624         doesNotNeedToCalculate = false;
00625         LOCAL_COPY(currentDelay);
00626     }
00628     
00629     if(doesNotNeedToCalculate == false)
00630     {
00631         feedback = calcFeedback(*delayTimeSamples, currentDecay);
00632         LOCAL_COPY(feedback);
00633     }
00634     
00635     float currentDelayMax1 = std::max(1.f, currentDelay);
00636     
00637     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00638     {
00639         int bufferSamplesRemaining = delayBufferSize - bufferWritePos;
00640         int numSamplesThisTime = min(bufferSamplesRemaining, numSamplesToProcess);
00641         
00642         numSamplesToProcess -= numSamplesThisTime;
00643         
00644         while(numSamplesThisTime--)
00645         {
00646             float bufferReadPos = bufferWritePos - currentDelayMax1;
00647             if(bufferReadPos < 0.f)
00648                 bufferReadPos += (float)delayBufferSize;
00649             
00650             float inValue = lookupIndexL(bufferReadPos);
00651             float outValue = inValue * feedback + *inputSamples++;
00652             
00653             bufferSamples[bufferWritePos]  = outValue;
00654             
00655             *outputSamples++ = inValue - feedback * outValue;
00656             
00657             bufferWritePos++;
00658         }   
00659         
00660         if(bufferWritePos >= delayBufferSize)
00661             bufferWritePos = 0;
00662     }
00663     
00664     LOCAL_COPY(bufferWritePos);
00665 }

00667 DelayN::DelayN(UGen const& input, const float maximumDelayTime, UGen const& delayTime) throw()
00668 {
00669     ugen_assert(maximumDelayTime >= 0.f);
00670     
00671     const int numInputChannels = input.getNumChannels();
00672     const int numDelayTimeChannels = delayTime.getNumChannels();
00673     
00674     if(numInputChannels == 1 && numDelayTimeChannels > 1)
00675     {
00676         initInternal(numDelayTimeChannels);
00677         Buffer delayBuffer(BufferSpec(int(UGen::getSampleRate() * maximumDelayTime) + 1, 1, true));
00678         generateFromProxyOwner(new DelayNMultiUGenInternal(input, delayTime, delayBuffer));
00679     }
00680     else if(numDelayTimeChannels > numInputChannels)
00681     {
00682         initInternal(numDelayTimeChannels);
00683         Buffer delayBuffers(BufferSpec(int(UGen::getSampleRate() * maximumDelayTime) + 1, 
00684                                        numInputChannels, 
00685                                        true));
00686         
00687         int inputChannel = 0;
00688         ProxyOwnerUGenInternal* proxyOwner = 0;
00689         for(int delayChannel = 0; delayChannel < numDelayTimeChannels; delayChannel++)
00690         {
00691             if(inputChannel == 0)
00692             {
00693                 proxyOwner = new DelayNMultiUGenInternal(input[inputChannel], 
00694                                                          delayTime[delayChannel], 
00695                                                          delayBuffers[inputChannel]);
00696                 internalUGens[delayChannel] = proxyOwner;
00697             }
00698             else
00699             {
00700                 internalUGens[delayChannel] = proxyOwner->getProxy(delayChannel);
00701             }
00702             
00703             inputChannel++;
00704             if(inputChannel == numInputChannels)
00705                 inputChannel = 0;
00706         }
00707     }
00708     else
00709     {
00710         initInternal(ugen::max(numInputChannels, numDelayTimeChannels));
00711         
00712         for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00713         {
00714             Buffer delayBuffer(BufferSpec(int(UGen::getSampleRate() * maximumDelayTime) + 1, 1, true));
00715             internalUGens[i] = new DelayNUGenInternal(input, delayTime, delayBuffer);
00716         }   
00717     }
00718 }
